sahneler.metin: Two minutes after launch, the Saturn V on Apollo 6 began to shake.
Suddenly the vibrations exceeded its design limits.
The fuel lines had their own resonance, like an organ pipe.
The structure vibrated like a tuning fork.
Later, engine lines ruptured and two engines shut down early.
A wiring error shut down the second one.
Pogo suppression was added before crews flew.

aciklama:
Apollo 6 shook violently and lost engines on its test flight. The cause: thrust fluctuations resonating with propellant lines and the vehicle structure.
